product.title: Giant Shopping Cart Limo Ride in Las Vegas
product.description: Ride Las Vegas in a giant shopping cart limo designed for fun photo moments and novelty group energy. Cruise iconic Strip corridors with your guide while passing Bellagio Fountains, the Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas Sign, and other neon-heavy landmarks that define the city skyline.
highlights: Ride the Las Vegas Strip in a giant shopping-cart-shaped limousine.
Pass Bellagio Fountains, major resort fronts, and the Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas sign.
Guided novelty experience focused on fun city views and group photos.

itineraryItems.title: Las Vegas Strip Departure
itineraryItems.description: Meet your guide and board the giant shopping cart limo for safety orientation and route briefing.

itineraryItems.title: Bellagio Fountains Corridor
itineraryItems.description: Cruise past Bellagio and surrounding mega-resorts while your guide points out iconic Strip landmarks.

itineraryItems.title: Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas Sign
itineraryItems.description: Stop for classic sign photos and short commentary on Vegas history and pop-culture identity.

itineraryItems.title: South Strip Return Loop
itineraryItems.description: Continue the novelty ride through major casino corridors before drop-off.

inclusions: Guided giant shopping cart limo ride

faqs.question: Is this a regular city tour bus?
faqs.answer: No. This is a novelty giant shopping cart limo ride built around fun Strip cruising and photo moments.
